title: Total dual Koszul complex
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\geq0$ and $f:\{1,\ldots,r\}\to A$. Write $K_\bullet=K_A(f)$ for the Koszul complex [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex]. The total dual Koszul complex $L^\bullet=\operatorname{Hom}_A^\bullet(K_A(f),A)$ has $L^n=\operatorname{Hom}_A(K_n,A)$ for $n\geq0$, $L^n=0$ for $n<0$, and differential $d_L^n(x)=(-1)^{n+1}x\circ d_{n+1}$. Its integer-indexed form is the extension by zero of this nonnegative cochain complex.

proof.text: Extensionality reduces equality of ModuleCat morphisms to equality on each linear map. Unfolding koszulDualBoundary and simplifying scalar composition yields precomposition by the composite of consecutive Koszul differentials, which is zero by koszulBoundary_comp.

proof_origin: Direct Lean proof by ext and simp using the Koszul differential square-zero theorem.
